newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on high Thai offer price.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on high Thai offer price.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Friday, supported by higher Thai rubber offer prices to Japan and the yen's retreat against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.0 yen to 2.8 yen per kg higher.
Benchmark October was closed 1.7 yen up at 143.9 yen.

A fall in Japan's rubber stocks as of May 10, was also cited as a positive factor for the market. "The market was supported mainly by short-covering. Sentiment improved slightly," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
